title: SleepMaMi: A Universal Sleep Foundation Model for Integrating Macro- and Micro-structures
abstract: arXiv:2602.07628v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While the shift toward unified foundation models has revolutionized many deep learning domains, sleep medicine remains largely restricted to task-specific models that focus on localized micro-structure features. These approaches often neglect the rich, multi-modal context of Polysomnography (PSG) and fail to capture the global macro-structure of a full night's sleep. To address this, we introduce SleepMaMi , a Sleep Foundation Model engineered to master both hour-long sleep architectures and fine-grained signal morphologies. Our framework utilizes a hierarchical dual-encoder design: a Macro-Encoder to model full-night temporal dependencies and a Micro-Encoder to capture short-term characteristics from biosignals. Macro-Encoder is trained via Demographic-Guided Contrastive Learning, which aligns overnight sleep patterns with objective subject metadata, such as age, sex and BMI to refine global representations. translated_title: SleepMaMi：一个整合宏观与微观结构的通用睡眠基础模型
translated_abstract: 尽管向统一基础模型的转变已经彻底改变了许多深度学习领域，但睡眠医学在很大程度上仍局限于专注于局部微观结构特征的任务特定模型。这些方法往往忽略了多导睡眠图（PSG）丰富的多模态上下文，并且无法捕捉整夜睡眠的全局宏观结构。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SleepMaMi，一个旨在同时掌握长达数小时的睡眠架构和细粒度信号形态的睡眠基础模型。我们的框架采用分层双编码器设计：宏观编码器（Macro-Encoder）用于建模整夜的时间依赖性，微观编码器（Micro-Encoder）用于从生物信号中捕捉短期特征。宏观编码器通过人口统计学引导的对比学习进行训练，该学习方法将整夜睡眠模式与客观的受试者元数据（如年龄、性别和BMI）对齐，以优化全局表示。微观编码器通过...
tldr: SleepMaMi是一个通用睡眠基础模型，采用分层双编码器设计——宏观编码器建模整夜睡眠的时间依赖性，微观编码器捕捉生物信号的细粒度形态特征——从而突破传统任务特定模型只关注局部微观特征的局限，实现对整夜睡眠宏观架构与微观信号形态的统一建模。
en_tdlr: SleepMaMi is a universal sleep foundation model with a hierarchical dual-encoder design—a Macro-Encoder modeling full-night temporal dependencies and a Micro-Encoder capturing fine-grained signal morphologies—that overcomes the limitations of task-specific models by unifying the macro- and micro-structures of sleep.
